title: Museum of Natural History

services.name: Education, outreach and tours
services.desc: Instilling a sense of wonder and excitement about the natural world and the unique place that is northern Nevada. Our museum is unique in that our collections and displays are of true scientific specimens. There are no props. And when you come here, you’re talking to scientists. It’s all real. There’s not a plastic thing in the whole place. Our lobby is open for self-guided tours Monday through Friday from 9 a.m - 4 p.m. during the spring and fall semesters. One of the missions of the Museum of Natural History is to instill a sense of wonder and excitement about the natural world and the unique place that is northern Nevada.
